ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Online Prompt Tuning for Grounding DINO under Weather Shift
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO (Swin-T) online by updating only the text prompt embeddings with an entropy loss on detections whose confidence passes a threshold, using an exponential moving average teacher for stable targets. Stream Foggy Cityscapes and BDD100K night frames in batches of 8, never touching source data or statistics, and report mAP50 on the stream together with throughput in frames per second against the frozen detector.
CONTROLS: Frozen zero-shot detector, full-parameter self-training, and normalization-layer-only updating; identical stream order and 3 seeds.
COST: 48
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 4 mAP50 gain with throughput within 10% of the frozen model; it fails if the prompt update drifts after 2000 frames, shown by decaying mAP50.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Full-Parameter Self-Training of GLIP with a Swin-L Backbone
PROPOSAL: Adapt GLIP (Swin-L) online by updating all weights with a self-training loss on pseudo-labels from a teacher copy, streaming Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, Clipart and Watercolor frames in batches of 8 and reporting mAP50 on the stream with throughput in frames per second against the frozen detector. Pseudo-labels are kept above a confidence of 0.4 and the teacher is refreshed every 100 batches.
CONTROLS: Frozen zero-shot detector, prompt-only updating, and normalization-layer-only updating; identical stream order and 5 seeds.
COST: 48
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 4 mAP50 gain with a clear loss in throughput; it fails if the full update erodes zero-shot accuracy on COCO val by more than 2 points.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Low-Rank Adapters with Source-Free Pseudo-Labels for GLIP
PROPOSAL: Insert low-rank adapters of rank 8 into the cross-attention layers of GLIP (Swin-T) and update only them online, with pseudo-labels taken from an exponential moving average teacher at a confidence threshold of 0.5. Evaluate on streams of Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night and KITTI frames, reporting mAP50 and the drop on COCO val to measure how much pre-trained generalization is kept.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, full-parameter self-training, and adapters of rank 4 as a size check; a fixed batch order and 3 seeds.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 mAP50 gain on streams and under 1 point lost on COCO; it fails if the teacher confirms its own errors, so that mAP50 falls after 1000 frames.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Full Fine-Tuning of Grounding DINO with Class-Balanced Pseudo-Labels
PROPOSAL: Update all weights of Grounding DINO (Swin-L) online with a self-training loss on pseudo-labels that are class-balanced by a running count of detections, streaming Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI and Clipart frames in batches of 8. Report mAP50 per stream together with the drop on COCO val, and rerun the longest stream with 5 seeds and then with 3 learning rates to check sensitivity of the adaptation.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, unbalanced self-training, and a variant that freezes the text encoder; a fixed batch order.
COST: 120
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 5 mAP50 gain on streams and a 2 point loss on COCO; it fails if balancing pushes rare classes into false positives, lowering precision in the later frames.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Normalization-Only Test-Time Updates for GLIP
PROPOSAL: Update only the scale and shift parameters of the normalization layers in GLIP (Swin-T) online, using an entropy loss on predicted class distributions of the boxes above a confidence of 0.3, with no source data or statistics. Stream Foggy Cityscapes frames in batches of 4 and report mAP50 together with the number of updated parameters and the latency per frame.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, and full-parameter updating on the same stream order; 3 seeds.
COST: 24
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mAP50 gain at under 1% of the parameters updated; it fails if entropy minimization collapses the scores of small objects, shown by a drop in recall.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Memory-Based Pseudo-Label Replay for Grounding DINO on Open-Vocabulary Streams
PROPOSAL: Keep a memory of pseudo-labeled crops from earlier batches for Grounding DINO (Swin-B), and when a frame has no box above the confidence threshold, train on a replayed crop with its stored label. Stream ODinW subsets covering 13 domains with their own category lists, in batches of 4, and report mAP50 with the share of frames that received no usable label, against a variant that skips such frames, using 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, skip-empty-frames self-training, and a replay variant with random crops; a fixed stream order.
COST: 24
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 3 mAP50 gain on domains where more than 20% of frames are empty; it fails if stale crops mislead the later batches, lowering mAP50 on long streams.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Confidence Threshold Calibration for Pseudo-Labels in Online Detection
PROPOSAL: Replace the fixed pseudo-label threshold of a self-training adapter for Grounding DINO (Swin-T) with a threshold set online to the 70th percentile of recent detection scores, so that frames with weak detections still yield at least one box. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night and Cityscapes-to-KITTI style frames in batches of 8 and report mAP50, the fraction of frames without pseudo-labels, and the precision of the pseudo-labels, against fixed thresholds of 0.3, 0.5 and 0.7.
CONTROLS: Fixed thresholds of 0.3 and 0.7, a score-rank rule that keeps the top box per frame, and a frozen detector; a fixed batch order and 3 seeds.
COST: 160
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP50 gain over the best fixed threshold; it fails if the percentile rule admits wrong boxes in empty scenes, lowering precision.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Prompt and Adapter Tuning of GLIP with a Swin-L Backbone on Six Target Domains
PROPOSAL: Combine learnable prompt embeddings with low-rank adapters in GLIP (Swin-L), updated online from pseudo-labels of an exponential moving average teacher at a confidence of 0.5. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI, Clipart, Watercolor and Comic frames in batches of 8 and report mAP50 per domain, repeating the full protocol with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, adapter-only updating, and full-parameter self-training; a fixed batch order.
COST: 160
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 5 mAP50 gain per domain, with the combination ahead of either part alone; it fails if prompts and adapters adapt to the same noise, adding no benefit together.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Test-Time Adaptation of Grounding DINO by Feature-Consistency Under Augmentation
PROPOSAL: For Grounding DINO (Swin-T), adapt only the last 2 decoder layers online by asking boxes to stay consistent under flip and scale augmentations of the same frame, which gives a training signal even when no box passes the confidence threshold. Stream Foggy Cityscapes and BDD100K night frames in batches of 8 and report mAP50 with the fraction of frames that gave no pseudo-label, against thresholded self-training.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, thresholded self-training with an exponential moving average teacher, and a consistency variant on all decoder layers; a fixed batch order and 3 seeds.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 mAP50 gain concentrated on frames without pseudo-labels; it fails if consistency is satisfied by trivial boxes, shown by unchanged mAP50.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Frozen Versus Adapted Vision-Language Detectors on Twelve Shifted Benchmarks
PROPOSAL: Measure how far an online self-training adapter moves GLIP (Swin-L) on COCO-C corruptions, Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI, Clipart, Watercolor, Comic and ODinW subsets, in batches of 8, with pseudo-labels from a teacher at a confidence of 0.5. Report mAP50 and the drop on COCO val per benchmark, and compare 3 learning rates with 5 seeds for the main configuration.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, and full-parameter self-training; a fixed stream order.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 4 mAP50 gain on most benchmarks, with the highest on weather shifts; it fails if gains on corruptions come with a loss on COCO val above 3 points.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Class-Agnostic Region Tuning for Detection with Unseen Categories
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO (Swin-T) online to target streams whose categories were never seen in training by updating a class-agnostic box head with pseudo-labels from region proposals and keeping the text side frozen. Stream ODinW subsets with 13 domains in batches of 8, and report mAP50 on seen and unseen category lists separately, against a variant that updates the text side as well, with 3 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, text-side updating, and updating of all decoder layers; a fixed stream order.
COST: 200
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 to 3 mAP50 gain on unseen categories and a smaller one on seen ones; it fails if the frozen text side limits recall for novel names.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Online Self-Training of GLIP with a Swin-L Backbone and a Teacher Refresh Study
PROPOSAL: Adapt GLIP (Swin-L) online with a self-training loss on pseudo-labels from a teacher copy at a confidence of 0.5, streaming Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI and Clipart frames in batches of 8. Refresh the teacher every 50, 100 or 200 batches, report mAP50 and the drop on COCO val, and rerun the best refresh period with 8 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, and full-parameter updating with a fixed teacher; a fixed stream order.
COST: 200
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 mAP50 gain with little sensitivity to the refresh period; it fails if a slow refresh lets pseudo-label errors accumulate, lowering mAP50 on the final batches.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Periodic Weight Restoration for Online Adaptation of GLIP
PROPOSAL: Update the prompt embeddings and the last decoder layer of GLIP (Swin-T) online with an entropy loss on detections above a confidence of 0.4, and restore 5% of the updated weights to their pre-trained values at random after each batch of 8 frames. Stream Foggy Cityscapes and BDD100K night frames and report mAP50 over time and the drop on COCO val, against the same update with no restoration.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, no-restoration updating, and full restoration at fixed intervals; identical stream order and 3 seeds.
COST: 36
PREDICTION: Expect restoration to keep the COCO val drop under 1 point at a cost of under 1 mAP50; it fails if restoration removes the adaptation gain on the shifted streams.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Full-Parameter Adaptation of Grounding DINO with a Swin-B Backbone and a Prompt Ensemble
PROPOSAL: Update all weights of Grounding DINO (Swin-B) online from pseudo-labels at a confidence of 0.5, with category names expanded into 5 prompt templates whose scores are averaged. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night and KITTI frames in batches of 8 and report mAP50 and the drop on COCO val, comparing 1 template against 5, with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, and full-parameter updating with a single template; a fixed stream order.
COST: 36
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 4 mAP50 gain with templates adding 1 point; it fails if template averaging blurs scores for small objects, lowering recall.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Exponential Moving Average Teacher with Low-Rank Adapters for Streaming Detection
PROPOSAL: Train rank 16 adapters in the language-image fusion layers of GLIP (Swin-T) online, with an exponential moving average teacher of decay 0.999 that supplies pseudo-labels above a confidence of 0.5, and drop frames with no pseudo-label from the loss. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI and Clipart frames in batches of 8, and report mAP50 and the drop on COCO val against self-training of all weights.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, full-parameter self-training, and adapters in the vision layers only; a fixed batch order and 3 seeds.
COST: 96
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 mAP50 gain with a COCO val drop under 1 point, against a 2 point drop for all weights; it fails if the teacher lags behind sudden domain changes.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Dual-Teacher Pseudo-Labeling for Grounding DINO with Source-Free Statistics Study
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO (Swin-L) online with pseudo-labels from 2 teachers, one with decay 0.99 and one with decay 0.9999, taking boxes where they agree above a confidence of 0.5. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI, Clipart and Watercolor frames in batches of 8, update all weights, and report mAP50 and the drop on COCO val, with 5 seeds and a rerun at 3 learning rates.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, single-teacher self-training, and prompt-only updating; a fixed batch order.
COST: 96
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 5 mAP50 gain with fewer wrong pseudo-labels than a single teacher; it fails if agreement removes the hard boxes, leaving empty frames more common.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Entropy Minimization on Region Scores for GLIP in Real-Time Streams
PROPOSAL: Adapt GLIP (Swin-T) online by minimizing the entropy of the region-to-word alignment scores of the top 100 boxes per frame, updating only the final alignment layer, and measure latency per frame in a streaming loop of batch size 1. Stream Foggy Cityscapes frames and report mAP50 with the latency, against the frozen detector and against adaptation of the full model.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, full-model entropy minimization, and an alignment-layer variant with a confidence filter; the same stream order and 3 seeds.
COST: 40
PREDICTION: Expect a 1 to 2 mAP50 gain at a latency increase under 10%; it fails if entropy minimization favors confident wrong words, lowering mAP50.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Six-Domain Streaming Study of Grounding DINO with Class-Aware Pseudo-Labels
PROPOSAL: Adapt Grounding DINO (Swin-L) online on streams of Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI, Clipart, Watercolor and Comic frames in batches of 8, with class-aware pseudo-label thresholds set from the running score distribution of each category. Update the prompt embeddings and the last 3 decoder layers, and report mAP50 per domain with 5 seeds, plus latency per frame.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, fixed-threshold self-training, and full-parameter updating; the same stream order.
COST: 40
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 4 mAP50 gain per domain; it fails if category-specific thresholds drop rare classes entirely, lowering recall on the later batches.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Temporal Box Smoothing as a Pseudo-Label Source for Video Detection Streams
PROPOSAL: For Grounding DINO (Swin-T) on video streams, build pseudo-labels for frames that have none by propagating boxes from neighboring frames with optical flow, then update the last 2 decoder layers online. Stream BDD100K night video clips and Cityscapes foggy sequences in batches of 8 frames, and report mAP50 and the fraction of frames with usable pseudo-labels against thresholded self-training without propagation.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, thresholded self-training, and propagation with ground-truth flow as an upper reference; a fixed clip order and 3 seeds.
COST: 80
PREDICTION: Expect a 2 mAP50 gain and a rise in labeled frames from 60% to 85%; it fails if flow errors move boxes off fast objects, adding noise.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Large-Backbone Adapter Tuning of GLIP with Teacher Averaging on Eight Streams
PROPOSAL: Train rank 8 adapters in GLIP (Swin-L) online with pseudo-labels from an exponential moving average teacher at a confidence of 0.5, and skip frames with no pseudo-label. Stream Foggy Cityscapes, BDD100K night, KITTI, Clipart, Watercolor, Comic, ODinW and COCO-C frames in batches of 8, report mAP50 per stream, and rerun the full set with 5 seeds.
CONTROLS: Frozen detector, prompt-only updating, and full-parameter updating; a fixed stream order.
COST: 80
PREDICTION: Expect a 3 to 4 mAP50 gain per stream; it fails if skipped frames dominate in clear weather, so that adaptation does little there.
